data.name: GCR2 Geoff Crammond
data.detailed_description:
Geoff Crammond Racing 2 (GCR2)

Geoff Crammond Racing 2 is a modern revival of the groundbreaking sim that helped define an entire genre. Based on the classic second instalment of the legendary racing simulation series, GCR2 brings the precision, challenge, and atmosphere of mid-90s-era open-wheel racing back to life.

Experience the golden age of motorsport simulation with a full grid of high-speed machines and race across 16 circuits inspired by historic locations from around the world. Customize your track names through built-in customization and Steam Workshop support.

Key Features:

  • Timeless Physics Engine – Rebuilt from the original codebase, capturing the raw handling, throttle sensitivity, and cornering balance that defined the era.

  • Classic Championship Season – Battle through a complete season of races, managing points, setups, and rivals.

  • Full Weekend Structure – Practice, qualifying, and race sessions with in-depth strategy.

  • Customizable Grid – Rename drivers, teams, and tracks to create your own fictional or historically inspired championship.

  • Steam Workshop Integration – Easily share and install community content, including liveries, names, and setups.

  • Manual & Auto Features – For newcomers or veterans alike—adjust driving assists, car setup, and camera views.

  • Replay & Analysis Tools – Rewatch full races and analyze telemetry to refine your performance.

GCR2 celebrates one of the most beloved eras in simulation racing. Step into the cockpit. The simulation that started it all is back—this is MicroProse’s Geoff Crammond Racing 2.

Geoff Crammond Racing 2

Rev up your engines and experience the thrill of racing like never before!

Geoff Crammond Racing 2 is the definitive racing simulation that puts you in the driver's seat of the world's most prestigious motorsport. Released in 1996, this classic sequel builds upon its predecessor with stunning graphics, realistic physics, and an immersive racing experience that captures the essence of Racing.

Are You Ready to Race?

Whether you're a seasoned racing veteran or a newcomer to the world of motorsport, Geoff Crammond Racing 2 offers an exhilarating and authentic racing experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Join the ranks of legendary drivers and prove your skills on the track!

Get ready to take the checkered flag!

data.short_description: Geoff Crammond Racing 2 brings back the golden age of mid-'90s open-wheel racing. Featuring authentic physics, full race weekends, and a complete championship season across 16 circuits, GCR2 lets you relive a defining era of sim racing with customization, mod support, and timeless challenge.
